svg.text: owner Jaydev · Verilog-2001 · parameters: DEF_EN=0, PERIOD_DEF=2500, DEADTIME_DEF=250
Turns the PID command into safe PWM for two BTS7960 drivers: shape → clamp → slew → per-channel dead-time PWM.
→ pin l_r_en_o, pin l_l_en_o, pin r_r_en_o, pin
REGISTER BANK · base 0x10004000 · ID 0x50574D01 · reads are registered (valid next cycle)
Hard rule: RPWM and LPWM never high together (dead-time FSM RUN_FWD / RUN_REV / DEAD). Duty and direction latch at the PWM period wrap (2500 cycles = 20 kHz).
